title: Report applied memory retirements when explicit import journal cleanup fails
outcome: An explicit combined folder import reports committed memory retirements even when it must stop after a journal cleanup failure.
acceptance: On Windows, explicit combined import reports the committed retirement and affected native revision IDs before returning a journal sharing error, and reports the retirement only once across retry.
A behavioral regression holds a real journal read handle without delete sharing, observes the failure and retirement notice, and confirms the retry does not repeat it.
